findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露多起集體訴訟仍在進行：Duramax 柴油排放集體訴訟（第六巡迴法院 2025-06 部分維持／部分撤銷並發回）及 8 速變速箱集體訴訟（2025-06 第六巡迴法院撤銷 26 個州子集團認證並發回）；公司無法估計可能損失。
findings.excerpt: In June 2025, the Sixth Circuit decertified all 26 state subclasses and remanded to the district court for further proceedings.

findings.claim: 2026-01-08 8-K：因消費者稅務優惠終止與排放法規放寬，北美 EV 需求 2025 年放緩；GM 主動縮減 EV 產能，Orion 廠轉產內燃機大型 SUV／皮卡，並把 Ultium Cells Lansing 廠權益賣給 LG Energy Solution。
findings.excerpt: GM proactively reduced EV capacity, including by pivoting the Company’s assembly plant in Orion, MI from EV production to the production of full-size SUVs and full-size pickups powered by internal combustion engines

findings.claim: NHTSA 於 2026-08 對約 997,743 輛 GM 皮卡與 SUV（2021–2026 年式、L87 6.2L V8）展開工程分析，評估 2025 年召回修復是否有效。
findings.source: ARY News／Reuters 轉載：US opens probe into 1 million GM pickups, SUVs

findings.claim: Cruise 相關證券詐欺集體訴訟（City of Hollywood Police Officers' Retirement System v. GM）：2026-02 E.D. Mich. 准許 GM 重新考慮動議，全數駁回對 GM 被告的剩餘主張。
findings.source: Paul Weiss：GM wins motion for reconsideration securing full dismissal of securities class action
